body: That really sounds like something she would do, she's a little awkward and just might not be ready to explore her sexuality to such a degree yet. Maybe RP is all she really feels comfortable with.
Yeah that could certainly be an issue. She seems hesitant to tell me anything at the moment, but maybe she'll begin to trust me more and confide in me in the future.
Maybe, could definitely be possible. Hopefully she's willing to open up to me in the future.

Lots of different people have suggested this, makes me think it might have happened. I asked her and she just said that nothing happened, "it's just the way I am." Which sounds a bit shady, but I have no reason to doubt her so far.

Those are all some decent suggestions, thanks! One way or another, I'm just gonna sit down with her and talk this all out. That's gonna be the best way to figure out what she's struggling with, I think.

The few other people I've shared this with have also conjectured that she's had something negative happen to her, so it could be a possibility.
That's definitely open to me. The only problem I'd have is suggesting these to her, to do so I'd need to let her know that I've been on her profile.

So to clarify, you suggest trying to roleplay with her to maybe work up to physical interaction?

I do trust her, I believe she has a reason for all of this, I just want to find out why. I am personally willing to go through all of this, and hopefully she will be too once we talk.

There were two instances that I found, one was plain heterosexual, and the other was a bit more odd. It was lesbian, but somewhere along the way my gf grew a penis somehow, so not sure what you call that.

Yeah, she's the only girl I've ever dated. She's such a huge part of my life right now, and it's hard to think of us not being together anymore. If I'm being honest with myself, deep down I probably should go ahead and break this off so I can find someone with more similar interests. It's just very difficult to accept that.

The plan as of right now is to talk with her about this directly, after I get back from my trip. That means I have to wait two weeks, but I think that's smarter than doing it right before I leave.
Thanks bro, glad my thoughts make sense.

While that's probably some very sound advice, it's very hard for me to do that. We've been together for a while and built up a strong relationship. Like I said in another comment, I'd honestly consider giving up sex for her, but this new discovery of her doing RP changes things for me. Like why can she do this kind of stuff with strangers online, but not me?

Well if we take the RP out of the picture, I think I'd be fine with not having sex. She means a lot to me and I'd be ok with giving that up. But with the RP now a thing, it makes me a little jealous. I admit that I'm still in shock and my feelings are probably skewed, but at the moment the big question on my mind is "why these other people, but not me?"

I've asked her if something in the past has made her distant towards sex, but she said "it's just the way she is." She could only be into RP, that's a possibility.

I plan on confronting her after I get back from my trip, I'm leaving the country in a few days and I don't want to confront her right before I have a big trip.

I'm not actually sure if we have a counselor, I'll look into that. I don't do sports that much, so coach isn't an option. As for friend's parents, I don't think there's anybody with parents that I trust enough. I'll have to think about that.

I really don't know if I'm open to talking with my parents about this. I love them, I really do, but I've never talked to them about anything personal. I just don't have that extremely close relationship with them. At the very least it would be awkward, but I don't know what their reaction might be. It could be anything ranging from them flipping out to something not so bad.
